domains.name: Commission rule engine, splits, math, cycle
domains.focus: Rule resolution, weightages SUM=10000 invariant, per-(branch|tenant) cycle policy, math for splits, edge cases (zero/negative, multi-payer, refund recompute, cycle boundary).

domains.name: Commission payouts router + service + tabs
domains.focus: Payouts router (list/create/approve/bulk-approve/void/dispute/mark-paid), payouts.service business logic, the five tabs (all / mine / review / payouts / liability), permission gates, RBAC by staffId vs members.id.
